_comment: The default pi settings a Hive-provisioned machine gets. `hive-agent workstation harness install` reads THIS file out of the cloned hive-pi checkout, substitutes {{HIVE_PI_ROOT}} with that checkout's absolute path, and writes the result to ~/.pi/agent/settings.json — but only when nothing is there yet. It never replaces an existing settings.json, and a machine whose tenant configures a private overlay gets the overlay's file symlinked instead. Keep every path in here expressed through the token: an absolute path baked in here resolves on the machine it was written on and nowhere else, which is the failure HIV-2792 named.
